description: Source code implementing ISO synchronization in Bluetooth controller, including creation, termination, setup, and management of ISO sync instances, handling ticker callbacks, and internal state management.

methods.name: ll_big_sync_create
methods.description: Creates a new ISO big synchronization instance, initializes context, allocates resources, and starts ticker for periodic ISO sync.

methods.name: ll_big_sync_terminate
methods.description: Terminates an existing ISO big sync, releases resources, and enqueues sync lost event.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_init
methods.description: Initializes ISO sync internal data structures.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_reset
methods.description: Resets ISO sync internal data structures.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_lll_handle_get
methods.description: Retrieves the handle for a given LLL sync ISO instance.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_by_stream_get
methods.description: Gets the sync ISO set associated with a stream handle.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_stream_get
methods.description: Retrieves the stream object for a given handle if active.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_stream_release
methods.description: Releases all streams associated with a sync ISO set.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_setup
methods.description: Configures a sync ISO set based on received advertising data and parameters.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_estab_done
methods.description: Handles completion of ISO sync establishment, enqueues established event.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_done
methods.description: Handles periodic ISO sync events, manages drift, timeout, and scheduling.

methods.name: ull_sync_iso_done_terminate
methods.description: Handles termination of ISO sync, enqueues sync lost event, stops ticker.
